ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity light-grey/white central pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey peripheral pixels located along the trailing edge and fluke tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-intensity field across the central and upper regions of both lobes. Low-intensity (dark) pigmentation is contiguous along the trailing edges and fluke tips. Discrete dark-intensity punctate blobs are scattered in the lower quadrants, notably more concentrated on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, medium-amplitude serrations with several distinct valleys. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-frequency irregularities with a more continuous linear boundary interspersed with minor pixel-level peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges (upper boundary) follow a continuous convex curve. Trailing edges exhibit a complex trajectory with overall concavity leading toward the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters present at the distal tips of both flukes, specifically at the extreme lateral margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct low-intensity linear features on the right lobe, including one prominent vertical mark and one curvilinear C-shaped mark in the lower-mid region. Left lobe contains sparse, smaller dark linear flecks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged notches and significant loss of edge continuity on the right lobe's trailing edge compared to the smoother left lobe profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark-intensity 'C' shaped pigmentation mark located in the lower-central region of the right lobe surface.
